scenario: A stranger online asks you for your home address.
explanation: Ask an adult for help! An address is personal information and should never be shared with strangers, even if they seem friendly.

scenario: You get a strange message and show it to a trusted adult.
explanation: Well done! Showing strange messages to an adult is always the right thing to do, even if you think it's nothing special.

scenario: You share your password with a friend from school so they can play with you.
explanation: Ask an adult for help! A password is a secret just for you (or your parents) — not even friends should know it.

scenario: A flashing button says 'You won a prize, click here!' and you ask an adult before clicking.
explanation: Great idea! Things that seem too good to be true are often traps. Asking before clicking keeps you safe.

scenario: You post a photo of yourself with your school name clearly visible, without asking anyone.
explanation: Ask an adult for help! Photos with details like your school can reveal where you are. Always check with an adult before posting.

scenario: A player you don't know asks to meet you in person.
explanation: Ask an adult for help! Never agree to meet up with people you only know online, no matter how friendly they seem.

scenario: You see a very strange video online and ask an adult if it's true before believing it.
explanation: Excellent! Not everything we see online is true. Asking before believing is a smart-detective habit.

scenario: After a little while on the computer, you go outside to play ball.
explanation: Great! Balancing screen time with playing outside and resting your eyes is really good for you.

scenario: You get an unknown file and ask an adult before opening it.
explanation: Very sensible! Unknown files or downloads can hide problems — it's always best to ask first.

scenario: An app asks to know your location and you ask an adult before accepting.
explanation: Well done! Location is personal information — asking an adult before sharing it is always the right move.

scenario: You see a new unknown game and download it by yourself without asking anyone.
explanation: Ask an adult for help! Installing unknown apps without asking can cause problems — always ask permission first.

scenario: Someone you only know from a game asks for a video call, and you say no without checking with an adult.
explanation: Great decision! Video calls with strangers always deserve a trusted adult's opinion first.

scenario: You see someone writing mean things about a classmate online and you tell an adult.
explanation: Well done! Telling an adult when you see online bullying helps protect the person being hurt.

scenario: A game asks you to buy special coins and you click by yourself to buy them.
explanation: Ask an adult for help! In-game purchases cost real money — always ask an adult before clicking buy.

scenario: On your gaming profile you only use a made-up name, not your real name or school.
explanation: Very sensible! Using a made-up name in games protects your real identity.

scenario: You took a photo with your friends and post it without asking if they mind.
explanation: Ask an adult for help! Before posting photos with other people, you need to ask if they also want the photo shared.

scenario: A pop-up says 'You are visitor one million! You won a new phone!' and you close the window without clicking anything.
explanation: Well done! Those impossible-prize alerts are almost always traps. Closing without clicking is the safest thing to do.

scenario: You get a friend request from someone you've never seen before and accept right away because their profile picture looks cool.
explanation: Ask an adult for help! Accepting requests from strangers can be risky — always ask an adult first.

scenario: Something you saw online made you feel uncomfortable and you go straight to tell an adult you trust.
explanation: Perfect attitude! Telling a trusted adult whenever something feels uncomfortable online is the most important thing to do.

scenario: You notice you've been staring at the screen for a long time and decide to take a break by yourself.
explanation: Well done! Noticing when you need a break from the screen shows you're already learning to take care of yourself.

scenario: An online contact asks you to keep your chats secret and not tell your parents.
explanation: Ask an adult for help! When someone asks you to keep online conversations secret, that's a warning sign — always tell a trusted adult.

scenario: You get a message with a strange link from a friend, but the way it's written seems different from usual, and you ask an adult before clicking.
explanation: Very sensible! Sometimes friends' accounts get hacked and send dangerous links. Checking with an adult avoids trouble.

scenario: You agree with an adult on what information you can or can't share before creating a new profile in a game.
explanation: Excellent habit! Agreeing on the rules with an adult before you start helps you play safely from the beginning.
